BiblicalUsage: Apart from, except, without — this is the word for the line that leaves God alone on one side of it. In Genesis 41:16 Joseph says it is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace, and in Genesis 41:44 Pharaoh says without Joseph no man shall lift up his hand in Egypt. In Isaiah 43:11 God says beside me there is no saviour, and in Isaiah 45:6, that there is none beside me.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word draws the line the whole Bible draws: apart from God there is no saviour, no answer, and no peace — and I hold that line with both hands.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
